children: Schema changes reach production with mix ecto.migrate from /opt/barkpark/api with .env sourced — run out-of-band from the code deploy.

On Production, migrations run with mix ecto.migrate from /opt/barkpark/api, with .env sourced so the DB credentials and PHX_HOST are present. This is deliberately separate from Deploy: the .githooks/post-merge hook recompiles and restarts the systemd Service, but it does not migrate. Schema changes are applied as their own step so a code rollback never silently leaves the DB ahead of the app.
The Search Vector is a Postgres
column, so it can't be altered in place — its migration
drops the column and re-adds it

, which recomputes every row instantly from the current to_tsvector expression. That is how a weighting change (title above body) lands across all existing Document rows without a backfill job. The same migration set keeps Postgres Search and its BM25F-style ranking in sync with the schema.

The Content Edges Table was introduced by migration 20260614230000, the schema backing the Content Graph and consumed by the Edge Projector. After a migration that changes index shape, expect a Blue Green Rebuild of the Indx Engine to repopulate bp_<scope>_vN. Always smoke-test the HTTP API v1 once a migration completes — the Fresh Install Invariant still has to hold.
